title: Occurrence, selected reference and projected custody controls
question: Which exact occurrence, authorization and payload facts survive the proposed library boundaries?
method: Exercise a pinned DuckDB finite relation, the production resolver with a fixture access port, and projected reads over two payloads from the production Arrow writer.

results.name: Arms retained by the compound recursion key
results.note: The key with node only retained one arm. Bag difference retained the expected duplicate occurrence.

results.name: Fixture partition acquisitions
results.note: The resolver requested authorization five times, including the stand-in refusal. The control used no native access.

results.name: Equal projected payloads with different byte and logical digests
results.note: The fixture changes one omitted flag.

conclusion: Preserve distinct role arms and multiplicity in finite analyses. Resolver reuse still checks authority per lookup. Projected IPC needs established full-byte custody and cannot identify omitted logical fields.
